children: Banner completed the merger with Pacific Financial and will issue approximately 2,654,563 shares of Banner common stock.
Banner and Pacific Financial closed the merger effective Sept 1, 2026; Banner is the surviving corporation.
Each Pacific Financial share converted into 0.2633 shares of Banner; ~2,654,563 Banner shares to be issued.
Former Pacific Financial shareholders will own ~7% and Banner shareholders ~93% of the combined company post-closing.
Bank of the Pacific merged into Banner Bank; Denise Portmann became an executive vice president of Banner Bank.
Pacific Financial had $1.26B in assets and 15 branches; systems integration to occur in November under the Banner brand.
